L20: cite1†Yosemite National Park L21: # Places To Go
L22: cite2†Yosemite Valley Yosemite Valley is world famous for its impressive waterfalls, meadows, cliffs, and unusual rock formations; accessible by car year-round. cite3†Hetch Hetchy Hidden in Yosemite National Park’s peaceful northwest corner, Hetch Hetchy Valley is a treasure worth visiting in all seasons. cite4†Glacier Point Glacier Point is an overlook with a commanding view of Yosemite Valley, Half Dome, Yosemite Falls, and Yosemite’s high country.
L23: cite5†Wawona Wawona is the home to the historic Wawona Hotel and the Yosemite History Center. cite6†Mariposa Grove The Mariposa Grove of Giant Sequoias is the largest sequoia grove in Yosemite and is home to over 500 mature sequoias. cite7†Tuolumne Meadows and Tioga Road Tuolumne Meadows is a large, open sub-alpine meadow graced by the winding Tuolumne River and surrounded by majestic peaks and domes.
L24: cite8†Crane Flat Area Crane Flat is a pleasant forest and meadow area located 16 miles (30 minutes) from Yosemite Valley. cite9†Waterfalls Yosemite is home to countless waterfalls. The best time to see waterfalls is during spring, when most of the snowmelt occurs. cite10†Rock Formations Over eons, rivers and glaciers somehow carved 3,000 feet into solid granite to create Yosemite Valley forming spectacular rock formations.
L25: cite11†Viewpoints There are many different viewpoints in Yosemite; Tunnel View, Olmsted Point, Glacier Point, just to name a few! cite12†Lakes and Rivers Very few lakes are easily accessible in Yosemite National Park. Rivers flow through Wawona, Yosemite Valley, and Tuolumne Meadows. cite13†Meadows and Wetlands What's so special about meadows and wetlands? Nowhere else in Yosemite will you find a greater diversity of plants and animals.
L26: cite14†Things to Do Find activities that fit into your Yosemite adventure! cite15†Accessibility Yosemite's goal is to provide the highest possible level of accessibility to our visitors. cite16†Museums, Buildings, and Cemeteries Yosemite is filled with history and there are numerous places in the park where you can visit a museum, historic building, or cemetery.   cite17†Image: Basic map of Yosemite and place names L27: Last updated: March 28, 2023
